posts.zh:
dsh-model-balance 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。自动识别当前模型厂商（内置 7 家），在输入框内显示余额或配额，未内置厂商可配置自定义接口。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-09362ea7e4bc614c46e4.html
posts.en:
dsh-model-balance is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-detect the current model vendor (7 built-in) and show its balance or quota in the composer input row, with custom endpoints for unsupported vendors.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-09362ea7e4bc614c46e4.html
